definitions.explanation: An attack using bombs, typically dropped from aircraft. Used in military and historical contexts to describe aerial bombing campaigns or individual bombing attacks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{爆撃|ばくげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{爆撃|ばくげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many buildings were destroyed by the bombing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{爆撃|ばくげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧になった。
examples.english: During the war, this area was bombed repeatedly and the town was reduced to a burned wasteland.

notes:
FORMS:
{爆|ばく} (explode) + {撃|げき} (strike, attack). Can also function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {爆撃|ばくげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bomb).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空襲|くうしゅう}→空襲：19775_kuushuu⟧: air raid — focuses on the aerial nature of the attack
- {爆撃|ばくげき}: bombing — specifically emphasizes the use of bombs
- ⟦{砲撃|ほうげき}→砲撃：19779_hougeki⟧: bombardment with artillery, not from aircraft

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆撃|ばくげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: be bombed
- {爆撃|ばくげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bomb
- {爆撃機|ばくげきき}: bomber (aircraft)
- ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧{爆撃|ばくげき}: indiscriminate bombing
